messages:
mira: After reading the RFC, quick brainstorm: we should build a lightweight admission facade that scores requests and routes hot/cold. primary goal: stable tail latency for premium tenants, graceful degradation for best-effort.

dan: +1. sketch: score = base_priority * tenant_weight - recent_errors - cold_penalty. route hot if score > THRESHOLD and cached-warmkey present.

kai: how do we cheaply check cached-warmkey? don't want per-request RPCs to operator. propose a negative cache with short TTL (10s). unknown -> default to cold for first few requests, send promote event.

mira: promotion flow sketch: facade emits promote {tenant, model, request_id, priority}. operator tries prewarm and returns a token. facade caches token. failed prewarms yield backoff.

orch-bot: ops note: promote API must be idempotent and include request_id for tracing.

dan: backpressure: facade maintains per-tenant token bucket + reads hot_capacity_gauge. Accept hot if capacity > inflight && take(1) succeeds, else route cold. no long blocking; immediate fallback reduces tail.

kai: headers: return X-RW-Admission: hot|cold and X-RW-Priority so callers/logs can show. minimal API surface change.

mira: metrics: facade.hot_routes, facade.cold_routes, facade.promote_requests, facade.denied_hot_tokens; label by tenant. alert if denied_hot_tokens ratio > 5% for premium tenants over 10m.

dan: multi-model requests: conservative rule = if any model is cold route whole request to cold. splitting at sub-request level is future work.

kai: accounting: add route_tag to telemetry for billing to differentiate hot vs cold unit usage. also provide a small Console panel with hot hit-rate + cost delta per tenant.

mira: deployment: central facade service per dedicated cluster for faster iteration (less duplication), RBAC for promotion calls. feature flag + kill-switch mandatory. rollout: small cohort -> observe hot_hit_rate and cost uplift -> widen.

dan: config prototype:
```json
{"hot_threshold": 80, "negative_cache_ttl_sec": 10, "hot_inflight_per_tenant": 12, "promotion_rps": 8}
```

kai: testing: synthetic bursts to validate sticky behavior, event-bus delay injection to exercise mismatch metrics, simulate hot node saturation to validate cold fallback.

mira: action items: dan -> prototype scoring + headers; kai -> promote API + rate limiter + negative cache; dan/kai -> metrics/alerts; mira -> experiment cohort and cost SLOs. I'll draft a short RFC with diag.

orch-bot: reminder: add feature-flag + emergency kill-switch endpoint before prod rollout.
